title: Changeset
description: Describes what was changed in an implementation and why. Produced by lambda, consumed by delta and axiom.

summary.description: One sentence describing what changed. Under 200 characters.

files_changed.description: Paths of files added, modified, or deleted

tests_added.description: Paths of test files added or modified

acceptance_criteria_met.description: IDs from spec@1.acceptance_criteria that this changeset satisfies

breaking_changes.description: Public API or behavior changes that break existing callers

commits.description: Git SHAs of commits in this changeset
